items.title: Bill Huntington Interview, 1961-12-27
items.q: I don't see why jazz musicians are so frightened to compose. I mean, Scott Joplin seems to me set a set of important forms.

ctx.x: What about Bix? You never got on a Bix kick ever?

No, because I think Bix is a frustrated classical composer, much in the way Thelonious is a frustrated classical composer. These people should compose. They do develop a facility on the instrument, which is really fantastic. But nevertheless, their forte, their main thing, their facet should be composition. And they should compose. I don't see why jazz musicians are so frightened to compose. I mean, Scott Joplin seems to me set a set of important forms.
You mean larger forms, not just old part-time?
